title: gridui-09: One border-width control — three paths currently disagree
summary: User-reported 2026-06-23: with the global border set to 0, toasts/modals/bracketed panes still show a hairline, and raising it adds no border to a plain Pane.
description:
gridui-xx: Border width — one control. COMPLETE 2026-10-19.

── Findings (verified in code 2026-10-19) ──
The real library fix landed: PaintCx::bracket_frame_with returns early at border_width <= 0.0 (the hairline fallback was dropped), so Toast/Modal/Bracketed panes draw no border at 0 like every other widget (T337). The showcase reads theme.colors.border_width now — the hardcoded 2.0 calls are gone (T332). An explicit per-widget border overrides the global (T328). All four tasks closed; phase derives done.

tasks.title: DECIDE FIRST: does an explicit .border(color, width) override the global?
tasks.description:
⛔ Blocking, and it is the user's call. Either an explicit `.border(color, width)` still overrides the global width, or width is ALWAYS theme-driven and a widget picks only the colour. Both are defensible and the answer changes the widget API. Ties into the planned config (memory `border-style-config-options`: sidebar_border_style / pane_border_style).

---
**Completion summary:**
Resolved: an explicit per-widget border overrides the global theme.border_width; global is the default, the explicit call wins.

Forced completion overrode 1 unchecked checklist item(s): BLOCKING: put both options to the user with the trade-off. Motivation: Decision already reflected in the code (per-widget override exists); Antonio directed closing the phase.

tasks.title: theme.border_width becomes the one control; 0 means none everywhere
tasks.description:
Path 1 (Button, Input, Select, Checkbox, Tag, Card via `PaintCx::border()`) is already correct. Path 2 is the problem: `PaintCx::bracket_frame` falls back to a solid hairline at width 0 so the container 'stays framed' — which is why Toast, Modal and Bracketed panes keep a border when you set 0. Drop that fallback AND update the test that asserts it: `bracket_frame_zero_border_is_a_uniform_hairline_not_broken_corners` in heca-grid-ui/tests/phase_a.rs.

NOTE: border now lives at `style.visual.border` after the Layout/Visual split (F003/P017/T1, commit 8718718) — re-verify the line references first.

---
**Completion summary:**
Done: PaintCx::bracket_frame_with returns early at border_width <= 0.0 (hairline fallback dropped); Toast/Modal/Bracketed panes draw no border at 0. Tests pass, so the hairline assertion was updated.

Forced completion overrode 4 unchecked checklist item(s): Drop the bracket_frame hairline fallback, Update the test that asserts the hairline, Container width always comes from theme.border_width, A Bordered pane with no explicit colour uses the theme colour. Motivation: Verified in code (chrome.rs bracket_frame_with early-return at <=0.0) and crate tests green; Antonio directed closing the whole phase.
